name: Effektiv Spenden
summary: A donation platform for Germany, Switzerland and Austria that passes tax-deductible gifts to charities recommended by evaluators (GiveWell, Founders Pledge, the EA Animal Welfare Fund, Longview Philanthropy, Power for Democracies), with its own funds and donor advice. Donors gave almost €30 million through it in 2025, about half to fighting poverty.

spending.source: https://effektiv-spenden.org/documents/Jahresabschluss-UES-Gemeinnuetzige-GmbH-fuer-effektives-Spenden-2025.pdf (UES – Gemeinnützige GmbH für effektives Spenden, Jahresabschluss 2025, compiled by its tax adviser: staff €583,254, depreciation €5,119, other operating costs €469,063); Effektiv Spenden Schweiz, audited Jahresrechnung 2025 (administration CHF 87,871, fees CHF 25,949); Effektiv Spenden Österreich, Einnahmen-/Ausgaben-Rechnung to 31 August 2025 (€6,999). At the IRS's 2025 averages ($1.128668 per euro, $1.203369 per franc). Donations passed to charities (€20.7M in Germany, CHF 7.0M in Switzerland) are donors' money, the recipients' cost.

lines.label: Effective giving: the donation platform, its funds, donor advice and outreach
lines.source: https://effektiv-spenden.org/documents/Jahresabschluss-UES-Gemeinnuetzige-GmbH-fuer-effektives-Spenden-2025.pdf (the three entities' accounts publish no programme split; its own impact evaluation counts every cost against its giving work)
